name: plan-ceo-review
title_zh: 先问该不该做，再问做没做对的方案评审
tagline_zh: 给 CEO/创始人用的方案评审：先推翻问题本身，再查架构、错误、安全、边界。四种模式从砍到只剩骨架到放开做梦。
tagline_en: For founders who want the 10-star product, not a polished 7. Four modes from dream-big to strip-to-essentials.
desc_en: CEO/founder-mode plan review. Rethink the problem, find the 10-star product, challenge premises, and expand scope when expansion creates a better product. Four modes: SCOPE EXPANSION (dream big), SELECTIVE EXPANSION (hold scope and cherry-pick), HOLD SCOPE (maximum rigor), SCOPE REDUCTION (strip to essentials). Then runs an 11-section deep review covering architecture, errors, security, edge cases
why_zh: 多数评审默认方案成立只挑毛病；它先逼你回答「这问题该不该这么问」，再决定扩scope还是砍scope。
why_en: Most reviews accept the premise and nitpick. This one forces you to defend the problem statement first, then decides whether to.
limit_zh: 只评审方案文本，不写代码、不跑测试、不产出修复补丁。需要你先把方案写成结构化文档；口头描述或白板草图它接不住。
limit_en: Reviews written plans only—no code, no tests, no patches. Needs a structured doc as input; won't work on verbal pitches or whiteboard sketches.
title_en: Plan review that questions the premise before the.
